steps.t: Assign a named pod to your queue.
steps.d: A strategist, a specialist, a developer and a coordinator are assigned to you, so you know who is on your work.

steps.t: Run the same week, every week.
steps.d: Stand-ups, a mid-week review with you and a Friday report give your team a rhythm to plan around.

steps.t: Work on your board, in your tool.
steps.d: Tasks move from brief to review inside the tracker your team already uses, so nothing lives in a side channel.

steps.t: Add or pause a seat as work changes.
steps.d: A new role joins when a project lands, and a seat pauses when work slows, so you carry no idle bench.
